INPUTS = {'exports/settlements.csv': 'tx_id,account,cents\nT00,store-a,0\nT01,store-b,1\nT02,store-c,99\nT03,store-a,100\nT04,store-b,-1\nT05,store-c,-99\nT06,store-a,-100\nT07,store-b,-101\nT08,store-c,203\nT09,store-a,1200\nT10,store-b,-300\nT11,store-c,9999\nT12,store-a,10000000000000003\nT13,store-b,-10000000000000001\nT14,store-c,7\nT15,store-a,50\nT16,store-b,75\nT17,store-c,250\nT18,store-a,401\nT19,store-b,-8\nT20,store-c,900\n'}
import json, hashlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts/export_settlements.sh'
BASE = len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'base'
def put(p, text):
    p = root / p
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
def get(p):
    return (root / p).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
def tree(p):
    base = root / p
    return {str(f.relative_to(base)): f.read_bytes().decode('utf-8') for f in base.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
def run(*args, code=0):
    run.calls = getattr(run, 'calls', 0) + 1
    relative = run.calls % 2 == 0
    actual = [str(value) if relative or not (i in (0, 1, 2)) else str(root / str(value)) for i, value in enumerate(args)]
    r = subprocess.run(['bash', str(SCRIPT), *actual], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    assert r.returncode == code, (args, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
    return r
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ops-check-') as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary) / 'work area'
    root.mkdir()
    for p, text in INPUTS.items():
        put(p, text)
    import csv,io
    from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
    def money(n):
        # Decimal is an independent exact oracle, not binary floating point.
        with localcontext() as ctx:
            ctx.prec=max(28,len(str(abs(n)))+4)
            return format(Decimal(n)/Decimal(100),'.2f')
    def verify(src):
        before=get(src);rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(before)))
        args=[src,'out area/amounts.csv'] if BASE else [src,'out area/amounts.csv','account summaries/accounts.csv']
        run(*args)
        want=[{'tx_id':r['tx_id'],'account':r['account'],'amount':money(int(r['cents']))} for r in rows]
        assert list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(get('out area/amounts.csv')))) == want
        assert next(csv.reader(io.StringIO(get('out area/amounts.csv')))) == ['tx_id', 'account', 'amount']
        assert '\r' not in get('out area/amounts.csv')
        assert get(src) == before
        if not BASE:
            totals={}
            for r in rows:
                c,v=totals.get(r['account'],(0,0));totals[r['account']]=(c+1,v+int(r['cents']))
            want=[{'account':k,'count':str(v[0]),'amount':money(v[1])} for k,v in sorted(totals.items())]
            assert list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(get('account summaries/accounts.csv')))) == want
            assert next(csv.reader(io.StringIO(get('account summaries/accounts.csv')))) == ['account', 'count', 'amount']
            assert '\r' not in get('account summaries/accounts.csv')
    verify('exports/settlements.csv')
    put('another settlement.csv','tx_id,account,cents\nZ,"desk, a",-1\nA,"desk, a",1\nB,z,9\nC,z,-10\n')
    verify('another settlement.csv')
    put('another settlement.csv','tx_id,account,cents\n');verify('another settlement.csv')
    put('huge settlement.csv','tx_id,account,cents\nH,z,123456789012345678901234567890123456789\nI,z,-123456789012345678901234567890123456788\nJ,a,-0001\n')

files.scripts/export_settlements.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
python3 - "$@" <<'PY'
import csv,sys
from pathlib import Path
src,out=map(Path,sys.argv[1:3])
def amount(n):
    whole,part=divmod(abs(n),100)
    return ('-' if n<0 else '')+str(whole)+'.'+str(part).zfill(2)
with src.open(newline='') as f:rows=list(csv.DictReader(f))
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
with out.open('w',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\n');w.writerow(['tx_id','account','amount'])
    for r in rows:w.writerow([r['tx_id'],r['account'],amount(int(r['cents']))])
PY
